panels.title: Endings without plot
points: Return to the opening image, changed
Let the light or weather shift

passage.title: Teacher-written model description for TGA
paras: [C] The lighthouse stands alone at the end of the land, white against a bruised sky.
[L] Below it, the rocks crouch in the surf; nearer, the path is slick with spray; at my feet, a rusted gate swings on one hinge.
[O] The gate creaks open and shut, open and shut, like something trying to speak.
[S] Salt stings my lips. The wind smells of iron and weed.
[E] Then the lamp wakes. A blade of light sweeps the water, and the sea, for a moment, is silver.
[R] When the beam passes, the rocks are darker than before, but I know now that they are watched.

keywords.def: communication: ideas, tone, structure (20 marks in Section C)
accuracy: vocabulary, sentences, spelling and punctuation (10 marks)

questions.q: Label the six CLOSER steps in the model and explain how the atmosphere evolves.
questions.a: C, L, O, S, E, R as labelled; mood moves from bleak and lonely to watched and safe.

questions.q: Which single word in the model does the most work? Why?
questions.a: For example: 'bruised', which personifies the sky as hurt and sets a heavy mood.

questions.q: Core: in the portal response box, write a full description from your CLOSER plan ('Describe a city street after rain'), 20 minutes. Starter: 'The street...'
questions.a: Four to six paragraphs following CLOSER with one dominant impression and a changed return.

questions.q: Extend: make three improvements with the success ladder (one AO4, two AO5).
questions.a: Three marked improvements, e.g. a stronger verb, a fixed comma splice, a varied sentence opening.

questions.q: What does the final line of the model do?
options: Returns to the opening place with a changed feeling
questions.a: A) Returns to the opening place with a changed feeling. It closes the circle with a shift in mood: R in CLOSER.

questions.q: Answer the ponder in one sentence.
questions.a: By returning to the opening image with a changed atmosphere.
